      Open without browser bars

      On iPad, open Rahyar in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. If shown, enable Open as Web App. Open the new Rahyar icon from your Home Screen.

      Browser tabs cannot always hide their address and tab bars. The Full screen button uses browser fullscreen when available.

      Settings

      Truck profile

      Enter the actual loaded dimensions and weight of your truck and trailer. Use metric units. Follow posted truck restrictions and signs. Map data can be incomplete.

      Presets use example values for the entire loaded combination. Verify actual loaded dimensions, gross weight, heaviest axle load and number of axles before saving. Canadian reference dimensions

      Privacy and data sources

      Your current location centers the map; map tiles are requested from OpenFreeMap / OpenStreetMap or Esri World Imagery. Destination searches use Esri / ArcGIS or Photon. Picking a point on the map sends its coordinates to these services to look up the nearest address. Starting a live trip sends your coordinates and vehicle type to Valhalla for routing. Truck trips also send your truck profile. City coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo for weather. Upcoming route coordinates are sent to Valhalla for mapped road-speed information. The route corridor is sent to Photon / OpenStreetMap to find additional mapped facilities. The displayed map area is sent to OpenStreetMap Overpass to look up nearby road markers. Saved places are stored on this device.

      Account

      Driver sign-in

      Sign-in will be available when beta registration opens. You can currently use Rahyar as a guest.

      TomTom traffic setup

      Paste your TomTom API key to show live traffic on the map. Requests for the area you view are sent directly from this browser to TomTom.

      Auto uses mapped municipal boundaries when available. Otherwise, it uses an approximate 10 km radius around mapped cities and towns, turning off beyond 12 km to avoid switching repeatedly. Fresh GPS is required. Includes highways through cities.

      Without Remember, the key is stored for this browser session. Browser-based keys are visible to the browser. Restrict this key in MyTomTom to rahyar-live-road.skippingfrog1.chatgpt.site.

      These are your own limits for this browser, counted by attempted requests. They are not your TomTom plan limits. TomTom usage across devices is combined in your account. Check MyTomTom Analytics for total usage and billing. Counters reset by UTC day and month. The overlay refreshes at most once every 5 minutes while this page is visible. Moving or zooming loads additional tiles.

      Traffic display uses your TomTom quota. Traffic colors do not change the current route or arrival estimate.
